title: Customizations
description: V10 — Progressive. V9's environments model with every Customizations page (the global surface, formerly "Configure") as the product's tree (with hover backgrounds): Connectors and MCP Servers (separate pages, with MCP state shown as in microsoft/vscode#337402, and On / Ask / Off on each row), Skills, Plugins, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools (with per-tool switches) and Canvases, grouped by User / Workspace · folder / Built-in with plugin, extension and organization source nodes (microsoft/vscode#344320). A context picker (Environment › Workspace › Agent, any part optional) narrows every page and its counts to what an agent would see there; with a workspace picked, On / Ask / Off sets that workspace's value. Opening from a session starts in that session's context. Clicking a row opens the item itself (file content; server status, errors, tools, configuration; plugin contents) and where it's installed, configured in place per environment. An environment can stay synced with another.
